sources.title: SaMD lifecycle standards (IEC 62304, ISO 14971, IEC 62366-1, ISO 13485)
sources.why: These standards define the software lifecycle processes and the design, risk and quality documentation a medical-device app must maintain.

sources.title: Post-Market Surveillance & lifecycle
sources.why: Mandates ongoing post-market monitoring, feedback into design, and documented reporting throughout the product's life after release.

sources.title: CRA — Cyber Resilience Act (products with digital elements)
sources.why: Requires lifecycle artefacts like an SBOM, a defined support period, and a documented vulnerability-handling and security-update process.
